passes.purpose: Rebuild repetitive geology and vegetation vocabulary
passes.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / substantial environment paintover.
Asset: ONE wide 16:9 fantasy world-map concept painting for a personal portfolio.
The attached image is the edit target. Preserve the FOUR CHOSEN BUILDING DESIGNS, their placement and relative sizes: upper-left ABOUT tree-root circular stone archive and round opening/bookshelves; lower-left SKILLS tall off-white helical canvas wind rotor with bronze shaft/gear mechanism and round making table; upper-right PROJECTS very large folded butterfly-roof open gallery with exactly four blank exhibit panels; lower-right CONTACT narrow spiral-stair lighthouse and crescent harbor. These designs are approved. Keep the small readable unboxed captions ABOUT, SKILLS, PROJECTS, CONTACT in clear sky under the corresponding islands. Preserve the Project island's visual dominance and the canvas framing.

Make a CLEAR, substantial change to the environment rendering, not another subtle smoothing pass. The current image still looks like a generative 3D toy diorama because every cliff has the same hundreds of almond-sized facets and every bush has the same little scalloped leaves. REMOVE that design vocabulary entirely. Keep the selected architecture but rebuild the cliff surfaces and painted vegetation.

Geology: hand-drawn monumental limestone landforms, big quiet slabs and offset horizontal strata, weathered planes and sparse long fractures. No pebble mosaic, fish-scale cliff texture, repeating pointed stalactite clusters, round stacked stone nuggets, or bevels on every edge. The facade of a cliff should have only a handful of major readable rock planes. Use distinct terrain rhythm per island: ABOUT a compact irregular shelf with a broad eroded face and visible roots; SKILLS a long layered wedge with staggered stone ledges; PROJECTS two monumental unequal cliff walls framing its central waterfall, with a broad deep shaded crevice; CONTACT a shallow curved shelf supporting the harbor. Do not change building identities or navigation layout. Leave some cliff walls completely quiet and bare. Moss grows in selective seams, not as uniformly spaced decorative dots around every perimeter.

Vegetation: paint broad asymmetrical foliage silhouettes with intentional negative spaces, a few visible trunks and branches, and 2–3 value groups per canopy. Foliage rendered as hand-painted brush-shaped color masses, not individually outlined round leaves. Sparse dusty pink blossom patches only on ABOUT's large old tree, varied cool/sage summer greens around SKILLS, muted ochre and olive accents near PROJECTS, spare dark winter evergreens and bare branches at CONTACT. Remove the blanket of tiny flowers and evenly distributed shrubs. Keep long quiet patches of grass/stone so selected trees matter.

Art direction: 2.5D painterly adventure-game environment concept, with the large color planes and clear shape language of Zelda Breath of the Wild environment artwork. Intentional opaque digital-gouache painting, sculptural but not rendered in glossy 3D. Crisp selected architectural contours, broad soft-edged secondary brush shapes, no black outlines, no paper overlay, no blur filter. Selective fine detail ONLY at archive entrance, wind mechanics and gallery exhibits. Distinct large-scale forms, adult art direction, avoid storybook-cutesy miniature finish.

Lighting/material: matte pale warm limestone, restrained soft brown timber, aged non-shiny bronze, ivory canvas, cool slate/blue-green shadows, fresh natural blue sky. One coherent soft daylight from upper left. Eliminate the golden sunlit outlines and little highlights scattered over all leaves/rocks. Retain natural color and clear atmosphere, do not make grey or muddy. Daylight does not require a bright highlight on every edge. More calm midtones; deep shade concentrated beneath roof and within cliff crevice.

Water: clearly sourced streams/pools feeding different fall shapes, with broad quiet blue-green bodies and only a few pale vertical foam strokes. Replace the sparkling zigzag/net-like white texture down every waterfall. ABOUT short stepped cascade; SKILLS winding shallow channel and two narrow falls; PROJECTS powerful central sheet between cliff walls; CONTACT low harbor edge spill. Atmosphere: simplified distant mountain silhouettes and long soft cloud banks with airy negative space, no busy cotton-ball cloud texture throughout.

Do not add buildings, islands, characters, UI chrome, neon, crystals, gold trim or fictional project screenshots. All four exhibit panels remain blank. Buildings stay grand and legible. The final result must visibly differ from the source through bold geology, irregular tree masses and a quieter, genuinely painted distribution of detail.

passes.purpose: Further simplify surface treatment into painted shapes
passes.prompt:
Repaint the attached image as a genuinely hand-painted 2D animation background / painterly 2.5D adventure game environment. This is a STRONG MEDIUM CHANGE, not a slight texture edit. Preserve exactly the composition, all four building designs, the new horizontal cliff strata, four blank gallery panels, and labels ABOUT SKILLS PROJECTS CONTACT.

Make every material decisively simpler and flatter. Use confident broad opaque digital gouache shapes, restrained painterly edges, and two or three organized tones per object. Around seventy percent of each cliff must be large uninterrupted quiet paint areas. Draw only a few long geological seams; REMOVE the dense mosaic of small masonry-like stones on every cliff. Remove nearly all the little white edge chips, white dotted flowers, grain, tiny leaf highlights and glint speckles. Canopies should read as irregular flat painted silhouette clusters with large shadow patches, not mini sculpted leaf clumps. Waterfalls should read as broad blue-green and ivory painted ribbons, without the repeating white lattice/faceted pattern. The mountains and clouds in the distance should have very little internal detail, with broad atmosphere gradients and soft painted edges.

Keep colors luminous but natural: sage and forest greens, warm ivory limestone, dusty pink blossoms, restrained ochre foliage, blue-grey shadows, soft blue sky. Matte diffuse daylight, one light source. No plastic gloss, ray-traced miniature shading, all-over ambient occlusion, bloom or shiny golden sunlight rims. The result should look substantially less like a detailed miniature 3D render and much more like a carefully drawn artist-authored background painting. Still crisp and dimensional at the archive doorway, wind mechanism, folded roof and lighthouse; not blurry, not a posterization filter, not low-poly polygons, not a sketch. No paper texture overlay. No new objects, architecture or text. Wide 16:9 scene.
